about: How scripts/friction.py recognises a turn spent fighting the factory's own code (FR-55). Closed variety: the spellings OUR scripts, hooks and validators use when they refuse a call (FR-13). Read by code, judged by nobody: a spelling this file does not hold is not counted, so the retro says 'friction' only for what it can name. traceback, guard_markers and validator_head_phrases are matched against the lower-cased result text; stand_markers and usage_regex against the original text. bookkeeping_scripts (optional, signed by the Lead) lists the factory scripts whose calls are bookkeeping rather than the role's own work, by file name, counted only when a Bash command INVOKES the script (the program an interpreter runs, or the command itself), not when the name is an argument of another program. bookkeeping_fragment_patterns (optional, signed by the Lead) lists file-name patterns of the fragments a role writes with Write or Edit for the factory's own forms; such a write is its own row (fragment writes).
